text:
19 hours ago Crispy microwave bacon sounds like one of those shortcuts that should disappoint. But when you do it this way, it comes out hot, evenly cooked, and surprisingly satisfying.
How to cook bacon in the microwave Photo by Intentional Hospitality This is my go to move for busy mornings and brunch hosting because it keeps the kitchen calm. You can cook quick batches, skip the splatter, and stay focused on the rest of breakfast instead of babysitting a skillet.
Image suggestion: A white plate stacked with crisp bacon on a checkered towel beside a steaming coffee mug.
Why we love this recipe It cooks fast in just a few minutes It is beginner friendly and hard to mess up No splatter and no greasy stovetop mess The bacon cooks evenly and stays crisp as it cools Great for brunch hosting because you can run batches quickly Works for meal prep so you have bacon ready for later meals Why You Will Want to Make This Recipe You can choose your perfect texture from chewy to extra crisp It works with regular bacon, thick cut, or turkey bacon Paper towels absorb grease for cleaner, more reliable results You can cook several rounds without heating up the whole kitchen The bacon is easy to move and serve with almost no cleanup When you are feeding guests, this method frees your hands for the eggs, setting the table, or pulling together something sweet. You can keep a steady flow of hot bacon going without a sink full of pans.
Once you try it, this becomes the simple breakfast side you reach for whenever you want reliable results with minimal effort.
Quick & Crispy Microwave Bacon Recipe
Ingredients
‚ñ¢Bacon, any thickness
Instructions
Line a microwave safe plate with 4 layers of paper towels to absorb grease. If the bacon strips are too long for your plate, cut them in half with kitchen scissors. Lay the bacon strips in a single layer on the paper towels. The slices can be close but should not overlap. Place 2 more layers of paper towels on top of the bacon to prevent splattering. If you need to cook more bacon at once, layer bacon and paper towels, finishing with 2 paper towels on top. Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Carefully lift the top paper towel and check for doneness. If you want crispier bacon, continue microwaving in 30 second intervals until done. Remember bacon will crisp up a bit more as it cools. Move the cooked bacon to a clean plate immediately to prevent sticking. If it is still greasy, pat gently with a clean paper towel to remove extra fat. ‚≠êÔ∏è This recipe was originally published on Intentional Hospitality
